lines.en: I wheel through the dark.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀划开寂静的空气。
lines.en: My wings cut the silent air.
I graze past the rock face.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶一圈一圈飞。
lines.en: I circle above your head.
I know this cave's dark.
I sweep between the stalactites.

lines.zh: 我贴得很低，几乎擦到你。
lines.en: I fly low, almost brushing you.
I don't land; landing slows me.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀大得不像身子。
lines.en: My wings are huge for my body.
I ride the air current across.

lines.zh: 我拐了个急弯，避开石柱。
lines.en: I bank hard around a pillar.
My flight makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我在洞口附近打了个转。
lines.en: I turn near the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上一起一落。
lines.en: My shadow rises and falls on the wall.
I climb a little over the stalagmites.
I cross over your shoulder to your back.
I hang from the ceiling, upside down.
In the dark my ears move.
The hollow's dark has seeped into me.
I wait for the nearby light to die.
I've eaten moths. They're passable.
I hang with my wings half folded.
Sound carries far here.
One ear swivels half a turn.
You can look up and still not find me.
I don't fear the dark. I live in it.
I hook my claws to stay put.
My teeth are small and sharp.
Wind enters the cave; I face it.
I count the dark patches.
Keep that little light down.
You're standing in my dark.

lines.zh: 我看你的脖子，看得清楚。
lines.en: I see your neck clearly.
You shouldn't have brought light down.
I circle close, taking my time.
Does your shield cover above?

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了洞里全是回声。
lines.en: I won't screech; the cave would echo.
The wingbeat is right above you.
Your cuff smells of burning resin.
Back into the light and I won't follow.
A tear opens in my wing membrane.
I drop, then lift again.
I veer in midair.
That left me trembling all over.
I graze the rock face and fall.
I don't cry out. I can't.
My claw hook slipped half an inch.
I stop and steady myself.
A little flight and this passes.
My wings can still carry me.
That's not my kind of food.
What you hold is too bright.
I prefer things that fly.

lines.zh: 这么点东西，塞牙都不够。
lines.en: That much would not even fill the gap in my teeth.
It makes me pull back.
Food doesn't lead me.
Wave it and I veer off.
Light draws others.
Put it away. Look elsewhere.
That temptation is shallow.
The hit knocks me half a foot off course.
I glance off your shoulder.
I hit the ground, wings spread.
I scramble back into the air.
You stepped on my wing.
I am so light your touch sends me drifting.
I wobble twice and steady.
Now my flight is crooked.
I retreat into a crevice.
You're blocking my air current.
Another is near the cave mouth.
We circle each other twice.
Its wings are darker than mine.
We dive together.
Our kind don't steal moths from each other.
It flies wingtip to wingtip.
We each keep a cave mouth.
It leaves first, silently.
The echo sees it off for me.
Next time the dark comes, again.
I hook it with a claw.
I snatch it up in midair.
It fell into a crevice.
I hang from the ceiling and tear it.
This pearl is too bright.
I hide it under a stone.
I will not carry this off.
I drape my wing membrane over it.
I search the drops slowly.
Flying with it throws me off.
You've entered my dark.
I drop low and skim the ground.
Nothing guards the back of your neck.
This dive is quick.
Your light is fading.
I am already at your back.
I won't need two dives.
In this cave there's only us.
The rock has closed off your retreat.
I've waited in the dark for this dive.
You run; I ride the current after you.
I stay above you.
You change course; I swing around.
I slip through the gaps between stalagmites.
Your torch still burns.
I dive, again and again.
Sooner or later you run out of breath.
Your soles rasp on the gravel.

lines.zh: 你换气那一下，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the moment you drew breath.
Half a foot more and I dive.
I dive and rake your shoulder.
My claws can catch in the rock seams.

lines.zh: 这一下撕开了你的领口。
lines.en: That tore your collar.
You raise the shield; I come around.
My teeth catch in your cloth.
I slam in and am thrown back.
Your torch is swaying badly.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的耳朵出血了。
lines.en: That left your ear bleeding.
Once I have struck, I climb away.
I don't stop. I keep circling.
I roll off the rock ceiling and drop.
One more pair of wings in the dark.
I drop, wings spread.
The hollow's dark raised me.
First I circle once.
My shadow moves on the wall.
I hear something living enter.
There's too little light here.
I grip a crevice and wait.
I sniff and find my bearings.
The torch singes my wing.
I hit the floor and sprawl.

lines.zh: 水压住我的翅膀，我挣不开。
lines.en: Water pins my wings; I can't free them.
The blast throws me into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿破了我的翼膜。
lines.en: An arrow tears my wing membrane.
Light stabs at me; I'm blind a moment.
Empty-bellied, I can barely beat my wings.
The flash whites out the whole tunnel.
No wind below; I just drop.
